description.value: One-way car share operated by BCAA. Every Evo vehicle is fitted with two Thule roof-mounted bike racks. Free-floating service in Metro Vancouver and Victoria — pick up any available car and drop it off anywhere within the zone. Evo Return is a round-trip car-share zone at Nanaimo (Hullo Ferry Terminal) and Tofino (airport and Harbour Air dropoff) — trips must start and end at the same Return Zone, so it is not a one-way option. Membership required before your trip.

Accommodates bicycles.detail: Every vehicle fitted with two Thule bike racks, promoted as core feature

Exterior rack.detail: All vehicles fitted with Thule roof-mounted bike racks (2 bikes per vehicle)
